handoffs.message: Implemented detail DTO/render honesty fixes in execute-plans (frontend-checkout) PR #133 (https://github.com/ajoe734/execute-plans/pull/133), task/MGMT-GAP-008 -> dev, not yet merged. Fixes: seed.ts normalizeBaseObjectFields recovers state/risk/name/owner/updatedAt from live BFF field-name aliases without fabricating data; StatusBadge/RiskBadge show an honest 'Unavailable' badge instead of the literal status.undefined/risk.undefined key; EntityHeader falls back h1 to id and owner to em-dash instead of blank; safeRatio/safePercent eliminate NaN% in CapitalPoolDetail (originally reported case), RebalanceDetail, DeploymentDetail runtime rows; capital-pools/:id, ranking-formulas/:id, rebalances/:id, research/:id now redirect to their canonical detail route via a new makeDetailAliasRedirect (generalized from the existing DeploymentAliasRedirect) instead of duplicate-rendering; Lists.tsx basePaths updated to canonical so in-app navigation no longer bounces through the alias; Tool/MCP/Skill detail pages show an explicit live-registry-empty EmptyState instead of hanging on loading forever for a seed id that is not live. Verified: tsc --noEmit, eslint on all changed files, vitest run (103 files / 1020 tests incl. 2 new test files), vite build, check-management-naming.ts. e2e/20-management-route-ia.spec.ts extended with the 4 new alias-redirect cases (not run against a live FE/BFF this session). NOTE: no pantheon-repo commit was needed/made since all owned artifacts are frontend-checkout: (execute-plans repo); please review PR #133 directly.
